title: Pursuing Stacks (À la poursuite des champs)
venue: Société mathématique de France, Documents mathématiques 20 (vol. I)
note: Volume I is published; the edition of the remaining sections is described on the editor's page as still in progress. The inventory names this folder Pursuing Stacks outright, so the correspondence is not in doubt.

title: Les Dérivateurs
editors: Matthias Künzer, Jean Malgoire, Georges Maltsiniotis
note: Transcribed into LaTeX by Matthias Künzer and edited with Malgoire and Maltsiniotis. Roughly 2,000 manuscript pages, and the fullest community transcription of any single folder in the fonds.

title: La Longue Marche à travers la théorie de Galois
editors: Jean Malgoire (§1–37); further sections by the Centre for Grothendieckian Studies
note: Malgoire's edition covers §1–37 of roughly 1,600 manuscript pages. The Grothendieck Circle separately holds typed versions of Part Ib and §49. Coverage of the later sections is uneven — this is the clearest case of a work that is famous, partly edited, and still largely untranscribed.

title: Esquisse d'un Programme
venue: Geometric Galois Actions I, LMS Lecture Note Series 242
note: Published with an English translation. The fonds folder is the dossier assembled for a 1984 CNRS application and contains typescripts of the text; the published edition derives from a copy in circulation rather than demonstrably from this folder.

title: Complexe de De Rham à puissance divisée et ombres des modules
note: CSG's unpublished-works entry states the source outright — « Montpellier archive Cote No. 136 » — so this mapping is theirs, not an inference from the matching titles. The transcription is listed but no PDF is posted for it, unlike most of their entries; the folder is the 1976 IHÉS lecture, their last public one.

title: Motifs
note: CSG's unpublished-works entry gives « Montpellier archive Cote No. 12 » for this and for a second item, « Esquisse d'une théorie des motifs ». Folder 12 is 167 pages and untranscribed here. The Grothendieck Circle separately holds a typed 'Motifs' derived from letters to Serre, which is a different document again.

title: Polyèdres réguliers · Géométrie de l'icosaèdre · Géométrie arithmétique des polygônes réguliers
note: CSG's unpublished-works entries name the folders: « Polyèdres réguliers » is Cote No. 69, and both « Géométrie de l'icosaèdre » and « Géométrie arithmétique des polygônes réguliers » are Cote No. 75. Three separate PDFs, all inside the combinatorial geometry run 69–89.

title: EGA V (prenotes)
venue: Circulated typescript; scan via the Grothendieck Circle
note: The inventory's own footnote to folder 24 records Blass's 1987 translation and points to the correspondence about it in folder 181/18 — which is why this mapping can be made at all.

title: SGA 3 and SGA 4 — re-editions
editors: Philippe Gille, Patrick Polo (SGA 3); Yves Laszlo, Fabrice Orgogozo (SGA 4)
note: These re-edit the published seminars, not the fonds. Folders 27–38 hold Grothendieck's working notes and drafting residue for SGA — related material, but not the same text, and not what these editions transcribe.
